sn37.1:1.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato mātugāmo ekanta-amanāpo hoti purisassa ||
sn37.1:1.3: Na ca rūpavā hoti || na ca bhogavā hoti || na ca sīlavā hoti || alaso ca hoti || pajañcassa na labhati || ||
sn37.1:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato mātugamo ekantaamanāpo hoti purisassa || || 3
